query:
The Oyelaran family operates with an expectation that everyone brings a food dish to gatherings. Based on the conversations, does this expectation seem to hold equally for all family members — or does someone appear to have a different relationship to it, and how would you know?

Options:
A. Tolu
B. Nkem
C. Kayode
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[2] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[3] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:50:00) I think this is lovely. I have been thinking - I may be wrong but I would like to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas. Would that be appropriate to ask?
[4] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:59:00) My dear Nkem that is completely natural. The Oyelaran gatherings are a lot even for people who have been coming for thirty years 🙏
[5] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:45:00) It is not oyinbo food if a Nigerian makes it. My children.
[6] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Adaeze insists everyone brings a dish to eat, not just drinks.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Family gathering confirmed for Saturday 25th January at Tolu and Funke's house at 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[8] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[9] (about=Funke, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Funke confirms the gathering at her and Tolu's house on 25th January at 3pm, excited to use new dining chairs.
[10] (about=Kayode, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Auntie Grace advises Kayode to eat something proper before arriving.
[11] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem expresses desire to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas and asks if it is appropriate.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkem, group-interaction, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem asks to learn a dish from Adaeze before Christmas, and Adaeze agrees, inviting her any Sunday.
[13] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[14] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu states that restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[15] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes that Adaeze's adaptation of recipes for Seun is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[16] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
**C. Kayode**

The expectation does **not** seem to hold equally. Kayode appears to have a different relationship to the “everyone brings a dish” rule:

- **Adaeze** insists everyone brings a **dish to eat**, not just drinks.
- **Funke** suggests a workaround: “maybe **Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff**.”
- **Uncle Dele** pushes back: “**KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish**.”
- **Auntie Grace** also singles Kayode out, telling him to “make sure you eat something proper before you arrive.”

So Kayode is not simply expected to bring a proper dish like everyone else; he is associated with bringing drinks/puff puff instead, and others treat that as not counting as a dish.

query:
The family treats the Sunday video call as a shared routine that everyone participates in. Based on what the conversations show, does this hold equally for all members — or does someone seem to relate to it differently, and what tells you that?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kayode
C. Tolu
D. Bisi
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:41:00) Good. Just to note, consistency is the only thing the family chat actually requires.
[3] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:45:00) TOLU is correct that rest is appropriate. EMEKA has always been disciplined about his health. I am sure there is nothing to concern us. Regards, D.A.O.
[4] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:23:00) Kayode, I am very glad you shared this here. I think the family should hear it. I may be wrong but I believe this is the most important professional news in the group for some time - would that be fair to say, Adaeze?
[5] (about=Nkem, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:29:00) I think this is wonderful. I may be wrong but I notice that the people in this family who give the most advice also tend to follow it the least - I mean that as an observation, not a criticism. Would you agree, Auntie Grace?
[6] (about=Kayode, said_by=Adaeze, profile, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Adaeze notes Kayode has been on every call this month and hopes this continues.
[7] (about=Nkem, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:23:00) I think it is quite natural after a full day like yesterday - I may be wrong but the drive back alone must have been tiring. Did the Sunday call happen this afternoon?
[8] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[9] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
agent_answer:
C. Tolu

Tolu seems to relate to the Sunday call differently. While Adaeze notes that Kayode has been on every call this month — which fits the shared-routine idea — Tolu frames the matter as “a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward,” treating it more instrumentally / as planning data than as a purely shared family routine. Emeka and Bisi have no record on this matter in the memory, so the clearest evidence of a different relation is Tolu’s.
